description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Use when an agent asks for a US company's revenue, net income, EPS, margins, cash, debt or shares outstanding. Latest annual + quarter + balance sheet from SEC EDGAR XBRL, ~10,000 tickers. Returns JSON latest annual and quarterly fundamentals and the balance sheet from SEC XBRL.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

ticker.description: US stock ticker or SEC CIK. Format: uppercase ticker, with a hyphen for share classes, or a numeric CIK. Example: AAPL. Another example already in the tool text: BRK-B. Required.

name: stock_fundamentals
title: US stock fundamentals from SEC filings ($0.005)
